title: Community support and regulation for gaming disorder among young adults
asked: Mr Gerald Giam Yean Song asked what more community support services are being developed for gaming disorder among young adults, whether the Ministry has studied jurisdictions with playtime limits or identity verification, and what direct measures beyond public education ensure the gaming industry embeds responsible features in digital products.
response: Dr Koh Poh Koon said counselling and intervention programmes for gaming addiction are available in the community through TOUCH Community Services and WE CARE Community Services. He said the Code of Practice for Online Safety – App Distribution Services requires designated app stores to minimise exposure to harmful content, including in gaming apps, and to put age assurance measures in place by March 2026. The Government will monitor other jurisdictions, including playtime limits or identity verification, and study whether safeguards for online video games are required. In supplementary replies, he said questions on app design are for MDDI, and described an approach of upstream education and working with developers and app stores on age-appropriate safeguards, balanced against personal autonomy and enforcement practicality.

key_points.point: Counselling and intervention programmes for gaming addiction are available in the community through TOUCH Community Services and WE CARE Community Services.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: There are counselling and intervention programmes available in the community for those seeking help with gaming addiction, such as TOUCH Community Services and WE CARE Community Services.

key_points.point: The Code of Practice for Online Safety – App Distribution Services requires designated app stores to minimise users' risk of exposure to harmful content, including in gaming apps.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: The Code of Practice for Online Safety – App Distribution Services requires designated app stores to put in place measures to minimise users’ risk of exposure to harmful content, including those found in gaming apps.

key_points.point: Designated app stores must put in place age assurance measures by March 2026 to reduce the likelihood of young users accessing age-inappropriate apps, including gaming apps.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: Designated app stores must also put in place age assurance measures by March 2026 to reduce the likelihood of young users accessing and downloading age-inappropriate apps, including gaming apps.

key_points.point: The Government will continue to monitor developments in other jurisdictions, including playtime limits or identity verification, and study if safeguards for online video games are required.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: The Government will continue to monitor developments in other jurisdictions, including playtime limits or identity verification, and study if safeguards for online video games are required.

key_points.point: The supplementary question on app design is more appropriately directed to the Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI).
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: the Member's first question would be more appropriately directed to the Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI)

key_points.point: The approach needs to balance increased protection for users against personal autonomy and the practicality of enforcement.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: we will need to look at how we can balance between increased protection for users versus personal autonomy, and the practicality of enforcement.

key_points.point: The approach has been to go upstream to educate and raise awareness, and to work with developers and app stores on age-appropriate safeguards.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: our approach has been to go more upstream to educate, to raise awareness, but also to work upstream with developers and app stores to make sure that there are some age appropriate safeguards

key_points.point: Measures will be evidence-driven, proportionate, feasible and checked for unintended consequences.
key_points.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
key_points.quote: we will continue to do in a evidence-driven way – looking at the proportionality of the measures that we are going to do, but also make sure that it is feasible and ensure that there are no unintended consequences of any measures we put forth.
